summary: Enhance your skills with our Certificate in Digital Transformation Strategy, focusing on innovation, cyber resilience, and practical technology applications.
lede: Digital transformation strategy training explains how to plan and guide technology-led organizational change. It is intended for executives, board members and functional leaders who need to lead transformation and connect digital initiatives with business priorities. Learners examine transformation goals, phases and success factors, assess technologies such as AI, IoT and Industry 4.0 for practical value, and consider how to safeguard digital assets through cyber resilience.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals eager to lead digital change.
audience: Departmental Leaders (Internal Audit, Risk Officers, Governance
